messages:
jordan: Kicking off canary deploy for service-llm-route -> v2.3.1. Rolling flag fastpath_v2: 10% now, plan +10% every 5m to 50%. Change window 03:00-05:00 UTC. Pinning routing version to v2.3.1. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.3.1 :rocket:

deploybot: [automation] deploy started at 1809998888. Canary hosts: 4, cohort=cf-992. Command: `/deploy service-llm-route v2.3.1 --canary=4 --ff fastpath_v2:10%`. Status: queued -> in-progress.

sophia: noted. I'll watch latency & p95/p99. @ops-oncall please be on standby.

mike: watching logs. p95 up ~+12% on canary after ~7m, error rate +0.5% (still within threshold).

jordan: hold at 20% for extra 10m, don't advance until we confirm kv-cache hit rates and attention kernel metrics. Ping me before next bump.

deploybot: holdpoint reached at 20% (1809998950). Autoscaling checks: ok. Telemetry snapshot: kv_cache_hit=0.67 -> target 0.80, avg_attention_latency_ms=18 -> baseline 15.

ops-oncall: grabbing runbook INF-ops-llm-route. Investigating slower attention kernel on canary GPUs. Respawning a couple replicas to rule out noisy neighbor.

sophia: suggestion: if p95 crosses +20% OR errors >1.0% we perform a soft-disable of the FF first, then rollback/pin. Prefer not to full rollback unless soft-disable fails.

mike: prepared soft-disable command: `/ff set fastpath_v2 0% --source=deploybot --reason="canary perf regression"` (tested in staging).

jordan: +1. Also prepare rollback pin to v2.3.0: `/deploy service-llm-route v2.3.0 --pin` and release-note blurb.

mike: executing soft-disable now. deploybot, run `/ff set fastpath_v2 0%`.

deploybot: queued command: `/ff set fastpath_v2 0%` (requested by mike). Executing... done (1809999012). Traffic slice removed from canary cohort. Audit id: ff-audit-8842.

mike: monitoring... p95 trending back down, back to baseline within 90s. error rate normalized to baseline.

jordan: good catch. We will abort the rollout and pin routing to v2.3.0 for now. @release-ops-bot please create a rollback note and link ticket.

release-ops-bot: rollback note created: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.3.1/rollback. Linked ticket INF-4123 (investigate kv-cache warmup + kernel mismatch).

sophia: minor impact, no user-visible errors reported. Recommend follow-up: add kv-cache warmup check to preflight and add a quantization regression test in the CI bundle.

jordan: agreed. Closing change window early. TL;DR: canary perf regression -> soft-disabled feature flag -> pinned to v2.3.0 -> no customer-facing outage. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
